lines.en: Why? You just dove right in?
You know, around age 12 I just started going for it.
Oh, God. Oh, help. Help me.
I fell off the toilet. I'm caught between the toilet and the wall.
Ugh, not you. Someone else. Get Pam.
I don't think Pam's going to want to come into the men's room.
Get Ryan. Oh, he needs to lift me. And he needs to clean me up a little bit.
No, he's not. I just saw him.
No. Can you just get up yourself? You only grilled your foot.
Oh, forget it. I'll just get up myself.
